images.alt: A comparison of the physical sizes of the phones Apple currently sells. The 16 and 17e are the smallest, with the 17 and 18 Pro just taller. The Air is slightly wider than the 16/17e, and taller again than the 17/18 Pro. Bigger still is the 18 Pro Max, the largest model. The new Duo is approximately 2/3rds the height of the 18 Pro Max, yet wider than any of the other phones even when folded.

Go fuck yourself #Apple.
